content.title: Helldivers 2 Updates
content.text: ARC Raiders moved away from free-to-play after looking at games like Helldivers 2, says Embark Studios CEO, aiming for a premium but affordable experience.The $40 price point was chosen to make players feel the game is truly worth their money, despite not having a traditional campaign.All reactions:Colter LeeAaand thats why i bought helldivers33Michael ReinkeHelldivers is a better game imo. I can play 100 mission in arc raiders and find couple blue prints and generaly get no where with in the game. Or I can play super helldive couple times and get an armor or gun I want to try in a warbond. They do need more warbonds cause I'm almost maxed out on all of them. Plus meeting random people on sos dives is hilarious fun. We laugh at getting blown up by each other or watch each other rag doll across a map on eradication mission against bots. Good times.79Banl NelYou loot for 30 mins then lose all that loot trying to extract and get killed by a guy camping the extract…8James AnsonI clocked in at over 1,200 hours and maxed out. I still play coz it’s so much fun helldiving for democracy! How about a nice cup of LIBER-TEA! Get some. Geeeettt soooome! 16David LambertHelldivers 2 is much more entertaining then archraiders. I literally bought archraiders played it a few times, got bored of the looting system & quick in and out games, then went back to spreading democracy lol Much more entertaining.56118Frankie Leesmart. they deserve to be paid for the work they put in. i've thrown hundreds at helldivers since day 1. literally the same case with arc raiders. both games are worth a gamers time. BOTH games remind me why i fell in love with gaming to begin with. i love both of them so much broGhoua XiongWell... why didn't arc raiders just keep the PvE and have friendly fire on? And put pvp on a different map/mode?Edit: none of you need to explain anything. I've been following the game since it was still in F2P and PvE stage.All I was saying is why not add friendly fire when it was still in PvE stage since they wanted to compare HD2 with Arc. It could have been like the division dark zone.7Dominic NoteboomWhy am I seeing arc raiders in a helldivers group 35
